description.value: Donair Affair is a BC-based fast food chain with over 20 locations, specializing in Mediterranean-style donair kebabs that blend Middle Eastern and Canadian flavors — one of the originals in the province for close to a quarter century. The Surrey Guildford branch offers beef, lamb, chicken, and vegetarian falafel wraps with a variety of toppings and sauces, plus Mayan-style platters and combination options. It is a quick, filling stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM phone number (+1-604-584-3839) matches the Surrey(Guildford) location listed on the website (+1 604 584-3839), confirming which branch this OSM node refers to. However, OSM records the address as '14786 148 Street' while the website lists the matching-phone branch at '10786 - 148 St, Surrey, BC V3R 3X6' — a clear discrepancy (likely a digit transposition in OSM). The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but all evidence points to Surrey. The website confirms an active fast-food operation with online ordering and explicit vegetarian/vegan falafel options; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
